name: allow-button-with-nothing-pending-does-nothing
description: The permission banner's Allow and Deny buttons do nothing at all when no request is waiting: no Yes or No is sent, nothing is logged.
reason: A click can race the request being answered elsewhere (a pad press, the turn ending). Falling through to Approve's no-request branch would send the word Yes as a prompt the person never meant.
source: AppState.answerPendingPermission (doc comment: 'no-ops when nothing is pending')

script.reason: Allow clicked after the request went away.
